Timing: start of your Command phase
Select: optionally, one combat doctrine from those below
Result: selected doctrine active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability
Duration: until start of your next Command phase
Assault Doctrine
- this unit selected to make an advance move: that advance move does not make it ineligible to declare a charge
Devastator Doctrine
- this unit's ranged attacks: [ASSAULT] gained
Tactical Doctrine
- this unit selected to make a fall-back move: that fall-back move does not make it ineligible to shoot or to declare a charge
Restriction: unless otherwise stated
- each combat doctrine selectable once per battle
- only one combat doctrine active per unit
- a rule making a combat doctrine active for a unit: any doctrine previously active for that unit no longer active for it
